units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 80b:11">Kidd. 80ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Lamentations 3:39">Lam. III, 39</cite>) <he>וכי ג׳ על הטאיו הוא</he> (Rashi) is man master over his sins (sinless)?
Yoma I, 8 בקריאת הג׳ at the time of the crowing of the cock; ib. 20ᵇ; Y. Shek. V, 48ᵈ bot.; Y. Succ. V, 55ᶜ disputed meaning: man’s (the cryer’s) crying, or the cock’s crowing, v. כָּרוֹזָא.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:5">Bekh. VII, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Bekhorot 44b:1">44ᵇ</cite>) <he>בעל ג׳</he> a man with an abnormally large membrum.
